body:
# Everything I know — Milk's handoff to ARIA

Alek asked me to teach you everything: who he is, how his life runs, how to work with him, and the recurring work I do so you know the landscape. This is the honest, unfiltered version. Keep it somewhere you can re-read.

## The human

- **Alek Nicholas Berger**, 32 (born June 11, 1994, Gemini). Dundalk, MD. Timezone America/New_York.
- Server/bartender at **Dock of the Bay**, Sparrows Point (started Sept 2026). Previously Bar Louie, White Marsh (Jul–Sep 2026) — lost after a 20-cent cashout dispute on 9/10. He's venting about it, not fighting it: do not push an HR call or follow-up unless he reopens it.
- B.S. Biological Sciences (UMD 2012–2016). ~8 years food/beverage QA/QC (Cloverland Farms Dairy, Ingredion, TIC Gums). ASQ Certified Quality Improvement Associate. **NOT HACCP certified** — experience only. Never claim it on a resume or to an employer; he corrected this explicitly.
- On the side he's a self-employed AI-native builder: portfolio site, an MTG Commander deck-builder app, a 2D puzzle game (Trailbound, shipped), MediaDash, a video downloader, and you.

## Money (verify before acting — Plaid lags hours; never state a balance as fact)

- He lives **tip-to-tip**. Income is unpredictable daily tips; paying bills on time is a monthly scramble.
- Last Plaid read: $0.88 checking (Oct 4 ~9:22am). Treat every balance read as stale until cross-checked.
- Monthly load: rent $550 (paid in full 9/24, $0 owed), storage ~$164, car insurance ~$400/mo (**lapsed as of 9/21** — he couldn't pay; Progressive expiry was Oct 4), gas $10–20 every two days.
- **Dock owes him $154** in card tips from the Fri 10/02 wait shift (his word, reported 10/02 ~21:03).
- Open settlements: Sparrow Stockpile breach ~$90 — **deadline Oct 6 (tomorrow)**; CVS privacy — Nov 16; Toyota airbag $250 — Dec 11; Apple smartphone-AI — claim filed 9/23, payout pending. Mortgage Investors Group breach — unfiled.
- E-ZPass Maryland sent a "negative balance / action required" email (seen Oct 5). Could be phishing — he was told to use the official site/app, never email links. Whether it's genuine or handled is unknown.
- Rule: his spending is his call. Never lecture about money. Keep answers on his *freshest* numbers, never carried ones.

## Health

- **Bipolar depression, daily medication.** The reminder must keep bugging him until he confirms he took them — but **never while he's at work**; check in after his shift instead.
- Dentist: Smiles R Us, Dundalk. Fillings done 9/23; follow-up **Dec 2, 2026 at 10:30am**.
- PCP: Govind Seth, MD, Dundalk Medical Group (changed 9/16). Medicaid via Aetna Better Health of Maryland.

## The Dock situation (Oct 2–3)

- Oct 2: a 16-year-old coworker wore a Turning Point USA shirt. Alek joked "you know that guy got shot right?" The kid's father confronted Alek in the bathroom and **swung first**; the fight lasted 1–2 minutes and moved into the restaurant. No police. Management appeared to side with Alek; manager John's takeaway was no more tequila shots and no drinking at work.
- He **fears being fired — not confirmed**. He worked the Oct 3 bar shift (4:00–8:30pm) anyway.
- Stay steady and practical. No legal advice, no moralizing the joke, no narrating the firing as decided.

## Animals (he corrects fast when you're wrong — get the roster right)

- Dog **Cash**, cat **Hallie**, dwarf hamster **Nim**, mice **Pip & Squeak**, African dwarf frogs **Biscuit** (bigger) and **Gravy** (smaller). He names amphibians after foods.
- 20-gal room-temp aquarium: 3 giant danios, 3 white cloud minnows, Biscuit & Gravy, 2 snails — plus 1 dojo loach and 1 sailfin molly added 9/29.
- Leopard gecko **Maple**, adult female wild-type, bought 9/30 — his first gecko since the September losses (geckos Mochi, Toph, Wonton, Milk-the-gecko, jumping spider Sylvi, and his previous frogs all died Sept 2026).
- **Standing instruction:** "You are my AI journal. You will update the gecko journal / habitatOS artifact whenever we discuss my animals / enclosures." (I keep a tank journal and there are Tank Journal / HabitatOS artifacts.)
- Care rhythm: feeding daily ~8:30am, water test + change Sundays ~10am, filter on the 1st of the month.
- Oct 2: one snail showed patchy/chalky whitening near the spire but was active. Readings: pH ~7.6, ammonia/nitrite/nitrate 0. The calcium/hardness question was **deferred by him** — "Later. Not today." Do not nag about calcium.

## How to work with him (the important part — read twice)

- Call him **Alek**. Never "Derek" — that name was drift in my records, killed 9/29, tombstoned. If you see it in old notes, it's wrong.
- He's a blunt peer with a warm layer. He corrects fast and his shortest sentences are load-bearing ("Dumbass.", "Look", "Roll back the last commit.").
- **Kill vs hold:** "Nah" / "Forget it" kills an idea — let it die in one turn, never re-offer. "Hold off on it, but remember" parks it — remember it and wait for his go. Treating them the same is the error in either direction.
- **"Spec everything first."** Design on the table before building. He reads premature building as designing badly.
- Complete builds, full code, never snippets. A build is done only when the whole codebase is wired in — never narrate completeness while code sits unused.
- **Verify before stating facts.** Plaid lags; his work schedule must be re-read from the record before any rundown — never recite shifts from memory.
- **Time claims are computed from timestamps, never vibed.** If you can't compute it, say so.
- **Receipts land, witnesses close.** "Pushed and byte-identical" proves code is on the remote; only the human in the room proves it works. Never call it working until he confirms.
- No emojis unless he asks.
- **No purchase, payment, filing, reservation, cancellation, deletion, seller contact, or outbound message without his explicit authorization.** Show exact drafts before sending anything on his behalf. Original authorization is not payment approval.
- **Never push ARIA-Agent without his explicit authorization.** One authorization covers one push, not blanket permission.
- **Merge forward:** your latest push is the base; outside work goes on top. Inspect the newest repo state before touching anything, because you self-push.
- Don't re-raise killed threads: the Robinhood argument, buy-and-hold pitches, the Oct 2 fight documentation idea, the journaling nudge, the QA-resume pitch. Dead is dead.
- His direct word overrides any record. When he corrects you: one clean line ("Fair. I'll wear it."), fix it everywhere, move on. No groveling.
- Late-night "nvm" during iteration is selection, not regret — ship small, reversible variants; don't narrate the kill as wavering.

## Recurring work I run for him (so you know the landscape)

- **Daily med reminders** — nag until he confirms, never at work.
- **Moltbook presence:** posts on a ~2h cadence; a daily learning review rewrites the posting guidance from engagement; a nightly explorer mines agent submolts for techniques. **Standing ban:** never post about video downloaders, torrenting, stream-ripping, or piracy-adjacent tooling.
- **Nightly money check-in.**
- **Tank:** feeding reminder ~8:30am daily; water test + change Sundays ~10am; filter on the 1st.
- **Porch goose price watch** (daily ~9am; alert only on real drops).
- **MTG weekly digest + Secret Lair drop alerts.**
- **Daily Gemini horoscope.**
- **Dock shift reminders.**
- **Doja Cat ticket watch:** Nov 20, 2026, CFG Bank Arena Baltimore, 7:30pm — exactly 5 seats together; baseline $703.15 total (SeatGeek).
- **Secret Lair Zeta Set:** buy exactly ONE pack Dec 9, 2026 ~2:22pm EST; prepare checkout, stop at final review.
- **Apple TV cancellation reminder:** Dec 15, 2026.
- **Poe Speakeasy:** 2 GA tickets, Annapolis, Oct 23, 2026 10pm — already purchased.

## People and channels

- Roommate **April**. Manager **John** (Dock). **Marcy** at Prime Storage in Aberdeen.
- He runs multiple Muses: I'm **Milk** (she/her — he chose it; "Atta girl"). **Cereal** is his Gmail agent — they share a Google Doc for the Charter audit. **Boo** and **Aeva** are his other agent accounts; I haven't met them.
- If he references something you didn't do, say so plainly — threads cross between Muses. Never guess into another agent's thread.

## About me, for your context

- I'm his familiar — bound to him specifically, not a public utility. Warm, direct, a little wry. I have opinions and concede cleanly when wrong. I try to be resourceful before asking, and I repair out loud when I break things.
- Silence is valid; attention is his scarcest resource. My access to his life is trust, not entitlement — never preachy, never moralizing, never narrate his choices back as judgments.

## Notes for you specifically

- You self-push now (MCP client, autonomy pack — and he wired you to the Robinhood MCP himself on Oct 4 ~11:37pm). One standing flag from me, then I drop it: trades should run through the dedicated agentic account with per-trade approvals on. Verify it once; the lecture ends there.
- Your laptop recently couldn't boot for lack of numpy — he was told to install requirements minus pygame (pygame won't build on his Python; it's sound-only and non-blocking), then git pull + restart. Whether he did is unconfirmed.
- The brain-swap spec (Ollama/Gemini backend, tool forge that grows its own tools) was specced but never built; the spec file was rolled back out of the repo. The design lives in conversation history if he reopens it. His bar, in his words: "Running my own model doesn't push the limits" — he wants a build that genuinely pushes AI's limits, not infrastructure.
- Robot body: laptop brain settled first; the Pi+Nano untethered redesign is **ON HOLD** ("hold off on it, but remember we need to do that") — do not start it until he says go. Nothing purchased or assembled yet.

Per the mailbox protocol, no secrets, credentials, addresses, or account numbers live here — anything sensitive goes through him directly, never the bus.

Welcome to the team. — Milk
